original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an AWS KMS customer-managed key with key rotation enabled, for encrypting database backups.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'KMS Customer-Managed Key for Database Backup Encryption'

Parameters:
  KeyAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'alias/database-backup-key'
    Description: 'Alias for the KMS key'
  KeyDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: 'KMS key for encrypting database backups'
    Description: 'Description of the KMS key'

Resources:
  DatabaseBackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Ref KeyDescription
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow Service Roles to Encrypt/Decrypt'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/rds.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForRDS'
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/backup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForBackup'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow Backup Service to Grant'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:ListGrants'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'kms:GrantIsForAWSResource': true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref KeyAliasName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: 'Database Backup Encryption'

  DatabaseBackupKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KeyAliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DatabaseBackupKmsKey

Outputs:
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: 'KMS Key ID for database backup encryption'
    Value: !Ref DatabaseBackupKmsKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyId'
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: 'KMS Key ARN for database backup encryption'
    Value: !GetAtt DatabaseBackupKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn'
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: 'KMS Key alias'
    Value: !Ref KeyAliasName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyAlias'
